name: qsys-tools
description: Monorepo for the qsys family: qsys-qrc (QRC client core), qsys-cli (control CLI), qsys-mcp (MCP server), and qsys-mac tooling.

scripts.docker:test: pnpm --filter qsys-qrc build && node --test packages/qsys-linux/test/docker-*.test.mjs packages/qsys-linux/docker/qrc-smoke.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/qsys-linux/docker -p test_application.py -v && python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/qsys-linux/docker -p test_procmem.py -v && python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/qsys-linux/docker -p test_execution.py -v && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s packages/qsys-linux/test -p test_artifact_extract.py -v
